subject.title: fix: ignore current OCM snapshot paths

question: Should doctor consistently interpret cached leading-tilde OCM snapshot paths relative to the OS home, even when `OPENCLAW_HOME` selects an isolated runtime profile?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and source-consistent, but the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision on the intended OCM snapshot-path contract before merge.

options.title: Confirm OS-home semantics
options.body: Merge the patch if cached snapshots are intended to preserve shell-style `~` meaning independently of profile-root selection.

options.title: Keep profile-root semantics
options.body: Do not merge; define the alternate persisted-path contract and adjust doctor detection only with an explicit migration or documentation rationale.

recommendation.title: Confirm OS-home semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the patch if cached snapshots are intended to preserve shell-style `~` meaning independently of profile-root selection.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository MEMBER who authored the proposed focused repair and can confirm the intended OCM behavior.
